title: Reading Drill — Saving Water at a Flower Stall
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Saving Water at a Flower Stall
passages.body:
**A** At a busy flower stall, stems had to stay in buckets of clean water. The seller recorded how often the buckets were emptied and noted why a full change was needed.

**B** Some buckets fouled quickly as small leaves decayed underwater. The seller removed the lowest leaves and used a separate rinse bowl for the first clean of each new delivery.

**C** The supply lasted longer without lowering flower quality. The seller still cleaned every bucket when closing, since water left overnight had a less predictable condition.
